founders.name: Zainab
founders.bio: With a passion for design and a keen eye for detail, Zainab leads the creative vision behind Event Atelier. She transforms ideas into beautifully curated experiences while ensuring every event reflects the personality and dreams of each client.

founders.name: Aisha
founders.bio: Aisha combines organization, strategy, and creativity to ensure every event runs smoothly from concept to completion. Her marketing mindset and client-focused approach help bring each celebration to life with purpose and precision.

members.name: Raina
members.quote: Great events begin with great planning.
members.bio: Raina is the organizational powerhouse of the team, managing logistics, schedules, and event timelines. Her calm attitude and problem-solving skills ensure every event unfolds seamlessly.

members.name: Sabrina
members.bio: Sabrina focuses on creating exceptional client experiences from the first consultation to post-event follow-up. Her warmth, attention to detail, and dedication help create memorable experiences for every client.
